page.overview:
Who is Dziega?

Dziega was an assimilated vran in Blaviken.

Dziega liked to drink beer near a stall at the town square with a werebbubb friend. He or she tried not to interfere in human affairs and felt antipathy towards people who were trying to cadge free drinks, to which she included Dandelion.

In the 1230s, during the famed Butchering, Dziega stood amongst the crowd of onlookers trying to dissuade the werebbubb friend from commenting, in fear that humans would be angry for weighing in and kill him.
